basic_info.description: Welcome to 109 Edna Street a beautifully reimagined 3BD/3BA home in the heart of sunny, sought-after Sunnyside! Thoughtfully expanded from its original footprint, this light-filled home offers approx. 1,800 sq. ft. of stylish, modern living. Enjoy peace of mind with brand-new systems throughout: upgraded plumbing with 1-inch copper lines, a full electrical upgrade with 200-amp service, and energy-efficient windows.  The sleek new kitchen shines with updated appliances, and all three bathrooms are completely renovated with a designer touch including a spacious en-suite primary bedroom that offers comfort and privacy. Fresh paint inside and out, new skylights, and gorgeous new flooring tie it all together.  Step outside to newly landscaped front and back yards perfect for morning coffee or weekend entertaining. The garage has a new opener and custom built-in cabinets for storage and convenience.  All renovations were fully permitted. Situated on a quiet one-way street with 2-car tandem parking, you're just minutes from City College, Glen Park & Balboa BART stations, dining, shopping, and quick access to HWY 280.  This is a turn-key home in a friendly neighborhood ideal for buyers who want style, comfort, and location all in one package. Don't miss it!
